entries.subject: Audit screen scope and authorization
entries.text: UI2 already produces fail-closed audit rows for device registration and local-identity administration, and has field-redaction projection code, but no audit query/controller or screen. This dispatch does not name the frozen audit-screen contract. Please name the contract or decide: event/table scope, reader authorization and own-versus-global visibility, filter/pagination and response shape, and redaction/refusal behavior. Implementing these security semantics without that authority would risk a privacy or authorization regression.

entries.subject: Audit query scope and authorization
entries.text: Scope: Global visibility (all rows). Reader authorization: 'security_admin' or 'compliance_admin'. Pagination: Top 100 recent rows (occurred_at DESC). Shape: id, occurred_at, actor, action, outcome, target. Redaction: Use existing projection code.
